data.exact_reserve_text: During 2018, gross ultimate claims in respect of prior underwriting years (2016 & prior) increased marginally by $0.6m (approximately $0.2m net). However, this is the result of a significant reduction in premium of $35.6m gross (approx. $14.0m net), offset by an increase of $25.1m gross (approx. $10.0m net) due to underlying claims deterioration. The drivers of the adverse experience are, most notably, from the Professional classes. There was also adverse experience on Aviation (Aerospace and General Aviation), Accident & Health and Aon Client Treaty, offset by favourable experience in Technical risks.

data.standardized_narrative: During 2018 Syndicate 1919 reported a marginal adverse movement in gross reserves for prior years (2016 & prior), with gross ultimate claims increasing by $0.6m. The deterioration was driven by underlying adverse claims development notably in Professional Indemnity (2014/2015) and also adverse experience in Aviation and Accident & Health, partly offset by favourable development in Technical risks. The movement was small relative to opening reserves (0.09%).

data.data_quality_notes: Amounts reported in the financial statements are denominated in USD (presentation currency changed from GBP). Prior-year development used is the explicit gross figure stated in the narrative (+$0.6m). A full gross claims development triangle is present and was cross-checked, but the report also contains reconciliations and narrative that explicitly state the prior-year movement. No individually named catastrophe events impacting prior years are specified. Some LOB-level impacts are described qualitatively but not quantified.
